agent_explanation: Close approach between bodies 1 and 2 (distance ~1.41 at step 8) causes strong acceleration that leapfrog substepping (11 substeps) fails to integrate accurately. Potential energy drops from -368 to -448 and kinetic jumps, producing net momentum drift: momentum_x jumps from 65.06 to 65.28 and momentum_y from ~0 to 0.127 at step 8, exceeding 0.115 allowed. Halving dt removes the violation, confirming timestep/force accuracy issue, not physical momentum source.
